jobs.title: Microsoft Fabric Analytics Engineer (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Sie haben schon einmal aus SAP-Auszügen und verstreuten Excel-Listen ein Datenmodell gebaut, mit dem ein Fachbereich wirklich arbeitet? Und Sie möchten Business Intelligence jetzt in einem Unternehmen von Anfang an aufbauen und Ihre Handschrift darin hinterlassen? Über unseren Mandanten Unser Mandant ist ein international tätiger Industriezulieferer der Mobilitätsbranche mit Hauptsitz im Großraum Kassel. Das Unternehmen wächst auf einer sehr soliden Auftragsbasis und macht BI und Analytics jetzt zu einem eigenen Thema. Warum diese Rolle Sie sind die erste Person, die BI und Analytics im Unternehmen verantwortet. Die Plattform ist gesetzt: Microsoft Fabric und Power BI, mit SAP als wichtigster Datenquelle. Die Datenbasis ist noch lückenhaft, und das Wissen über BI wächst in der Organisation gerade erst. Beides bauen Sie mit auf. Weil Sie die BI-Landschaft von Anfang an prägen und Ihre Entscheidungen darin Bestand haben. Weil Sie direkt an die IT-Leitung angebunden sind und Ihre Ergebnisse im ganzen Unternehmen sichtbar werden. Weil in einer Aufbauphase Ausprobieren dazugehört und eine erfahrene IT-Leitung Ihnen dabei Rückhalt gibt. Das sind Ihre Aufgaben Sie bauen die BI-Landschaft auf Microsoft Fabric auf: Datenanbindung, vor allem aus SAP, Lakehouse oder Warehouse sowie Pipelines und Dataflows. Sie entwickeln zentrale, wiederverwendbare Datenmodelle in Power BI, auf denen weitere Berichte aufsetzen. Sie erstellen die ersten Basisberichte für die Fachbereiche. Sie etablieren Report-Governance: Workspaces, zertifizierte Datenmodelle, Namenskonventionen, Berechtigungen und Deployment. Sie machen Lücken in der Datenqualität sichtbar und bereinigen sie gemeinsam mit den Fachbereichen. Sie nehmen Anforderungen auf, holen die Beteiligten an einen Tisch und setzen Prioritäten. Sie befähigen die Fachbereiche zu Self-Service mit klaren Leitplanken und zeigen den Kolleginnen und Kollegen, wie man einen Bereich und eine Analyse strukturiert. Zur Einordnung: Ihr Schwerpunkt lie

jobs.description: Description Our quantum sensing technology is already operating in customer environments across United States, Asia and Europe. As our installed base grows and we move from first deployments to repeat orders, ensuring the reliability and performance of every system becomes increasingly important. You’ll work directly with leading semiconductor foundries, IDMs, and OSATs, ensuring our systems operate reliably and consistently meet their specifications. You’ll collaborate closely with our Engineering and Applications teams, combining technical problem-solving with a strong customer focus. This is also an opportunity to help shape our global service function from an early stage, introducing the processes, tools, and standards that will support our growing international installed base. jobs.title: Microsoft 365 Administrator (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Sie haben schon einmal einen gewachsenen Microsoft-365-Tenant aufgeräumt: Gruppen zusammengeführt, Rechte und Zugriffe neu geregelt und Richtlinien so aufgesetzt, dass alles verlässlich läuft? Und Sie möchten diese Verantwortung jetzt für ein Unternehmen mit Standorten in mehreren Ländern übernehmen? Über unseren Mandanten Unser Mandant ist ein international tätiger Industriezulieferer der Mobilitätsbranche mit Hauptsitz im Großraum Kassel. Das Unternehmen wächst auf einer sehr soliden Auftragsbasis, und die IT soll dieses Wachstum mit zuverlässigen Services begleiten. Warum diese Rolle? Die IT-Infrastruktur soll jetzt Schritt für Schritt sauber aufgestellt werden. Rollen, Gruppen und Gruppenrichtlinien sind über die Zeit entstanden und brauchen eine klare Ordnung. Zugleich soll der Tenant alle Standorte sauber abbilden, und der weitere Rollout von Microsoft 365 in die Organisation steht an. Weil Sie Ihre Vorstellung eines sauberen Tenants einbringen und die Verantwortung dafür tragen. Weil Sie die Roadmap für den weiteren Rollout von Anfang an prägen. Weil am Ende ein Backend steht, auf das sich das Unternehmen beim Wachsen verlassen kann. Das sind Ihre Aufgaben Sie ordnen Rollen, Gruppen und Berechtigungen neu: Gruppen zusammenführen, Namenskonventionen festlegen, ein Rollenkonzept mit RBAC und Privileged Identity Management aufbauen, bei Bedarf mit Administrative Units je Land. Sie verantworten Identitäten und Zugriffe in Entra ID, je nach Umgebung hybrid mit lokalem Active Directory, einschließlich Conditional Access und MFA. jobs.description: About Heidi Systems Heidi Systems is building the data infrastructure layer for buildings and energy. We help property owners and managers digitize metering, consumption data, reporting and billing in one of Europe's largest and most outdated infrastructure markets. We're hiring a senior engineer to own DevOps and data infrastructure. You'll be responsible for how our systems get built, deployed, monitored and kept running. And you'll make the architecture calls together with the founders. Tasks What you'll own • Our deployment pipeline and production environment, end to end (CI/CD, containers, servers) • Monitoring, alerting and incident response, so problems show up before customers notice them • Data ingestion and processing for meter, gateway and building data, including MQTT/IoT streams • Database operations: Postgres setup, clustering, backups, performance • Backend services in Go and TypeScript • Validating and transforming high-volume device and consumption data • Debugging real-world issues across gateways, MQTT, APIs and databases • Internal tooling that automates our operations • Architecture decisions with the founding team, plus the engineering standards the rest of the team builds on Requirements Who we're looking for You've run production infrastructure before and you know what breaks at 2am. You make decisions on your own, explain the trade-offs, and take responsibility for the outcome. You're a great fit if you: • Have several years of hands-on experience in a DevOps, SRE, platform or backend role with production responsibility • Have built and maintained CI/CD pipelines and containerized deployments yourself • Write strong Go and/or TypeScript • Have run Postgres (or a comparable relational database) in production • Have set up monitoring and logging and handled real incidents • Can design a system from scratch and defend the choices Bonus: MQTT, IoT or time-series data, bare-metal/VPS setups (we run on Hetzner), experience in energy or real estate

jobs.title: Marketing Manager
jobs.description: Du liebst es, Events auf die Beine zu stellen, und weißt, wie man Social-Media-Kanäle lebendig hält? Dann passt du zu uns. Als Marketing Manager sorgst du dafür, dass unsere Messen und Veranstaltungen reibungslos laufen und unsere Social-Media-Kanäle konsequent bespielt werden. Du arbeitest eng mit der Marketingleitung zusammen, hältst im Team die Fäden zusammen und wächst mit der Zeit in weitere Marketingbereiche hinein. Die Take Care Immobilien GmbH entwickelt Senioren- und Pflegeimmobilien und bietet sie Kapitalanlegern als langfristige und nachhaltige Investition an. Damit schaffen wir ein Zuhause für Menschen, die Unterstützung brauchen, und eine Antwort auf den demografischen Wandel. Bei uns triffst du auf kurze Entscheidungswege und flache Hierarchien, getragen von erfahrenen Gesellschaftern. Du arbeitest in einem kleinen Marketingteam, in dem deine Ideen gehört und umgesetzt werden. Deine Aufgaben: Du recherchierst und bewertest neue Messen und Veranstaltungen und bringst sie für uns an den Start. Du planst und setzt Messen, Netzwerkveranstaltungen, Webinare und Objektvorstellungen in Abstimmung mit der Marketingleitung um. Du übernimmst die komplette Organisation rund um jedes Event: Anmeldung, Standplanung, Hotel und Reise, Material sowie die Abstimmung mit Ausstellern und Dienstleistern. Du begleitest eigene Formate wie Tage der offenen Tür, Preisbewerbungen und Postmailings. Du bereitest jedes Event sauber nach: Du übergibst Kontakte ins CRM, sammelst Fotos und Material und hältst Learnings fest. Du steuerst unsere Social-Media-Kanäle (Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, YouTube), planst Beiträge nach Redaktionsplan ein und veröffentlichst sie. Du betreust Stories, zum Beispiel Einblicke hinter die Kulissen und von unterwegs, und kümmerst dich um das Community-Management. Du hältst Kanäle und Profile aktuell und gestaltest die Ausrichtung der Kanäle aktiv mit. Du recherchierst Themen, schreibst Texte und Captions und erstellst Briefings für Grafik und Video.

jobs.description: At Moss, we give finance professionals the power to automate their day-to-day and make forward-thinking decisions. We're hiring a Head of Engineering to lead engineering for one of our product tribes. You'll manage 15 to 20 engineers directly, with tech leads in each squad owning technical direction but no management layer between you and the team. You report to the CTO and sit in a tribe leadership trio with the Product Tribe Lead and Design Lead. Which tribe you'd lead is something we'll work out with you during the process. Management is anchored at tribe level, squad composition flexes to serve the most important work, and structure changes as we learn (roughly every six months in practice, not on a schedule). jobs.title: Working Student / Intern Finance & Operations (m/f/d)
jobs.description: Your mission About GENUINE GENUINE is Europe’s leading TikTok Shop agency, and we’re right in the middle of the social commerce revolution. We don’t just make content. We build shopping experiences that sell, at the speed of a viral trend. We’re growing fast, and so does our Finance & Operations team. The Mission Behind every viral LIVE and every creator campaign, a lot of money moves: platform fees, creator commissions, client payouts. You’ll help keep all of it clean, on time and under control. You’ll see how a hypergrowth agency really runs, and you’ll learn more in a few months than in most full-time jobs. What You’ll Do Follow the money: Match TikTok Shop settlements, fees and affiliate commissions against our records, and catch every gap. Turn data into insights: Build and maintain the reports that show which creators and LIVE sessions actually make money. Keep creators happy: Prepare payout lists, check invoices and make sure everyone gets paid correctly and on time. Keep the books tidy: Collect and organize invoices and receipts so accounting and our tax advisor have everything they need. Automate the boring stuff: Help set up tools that connect TikTok Shop data with our accounting software. Have a say in strategy: Run analyses for pricing, client offers and leadership decisions. Your profile Who You Are Student: You’re studying Business, Finance, Economics, Business Informatics or something similar, and you want a working student job or an internship. Excel nerd: Pivot tables and XLOOKUP don’t scare you. You enjoy finding patterns in messy data. Detail lover: A missing cent bothers you, and you won’t rest until you find it. Fast learner: You’re comfortable in organized chaos, you ask questions, and you get things done. Bonus points: You’ve worked in finance or e-commerce before, or you already know TikTok Shop, Shopify, Moss or Spendesk. Language: You speak fluent English. German is nice to have, but you don’t need it. Why us? Flexible hours: 16 to 40 hours

jobs.title: FPGA Firmware Engineer
jobs.description: About Singular Photonics: Singular Photonics is a fast-growing fabless semiconductor start-up, developing Single-Photon Avalanche Diode (SPAD) sensors that bring advanced computation directly into imaging. Our sensors enable innovations across LiDAR, fluorescence lifetime imaging (FLIM), spectroscopy and time-resolved optical measurements, powering next-generation solutions for customers worldwide. Based at Orchard Brae House in Edinburgh, we are a close-knit team at the forefront of the photonics revolution. About the Role: We are seeking an FPGA Firmware Engineer to join our multidisciplinary R&D team. This is an FPGA role: you will design, implement and verify the Verilog firmware that powers our SPAD sensors, captures photon timing data at high rates and streams it to the host. Our sensors generate data faster than most imaging systems ever see, so the interesting problems here are real ones: clock domain crossing, timing closure and getting data off the device without losing a photon. You will work alongside our hardware, ASIC and software engineers, from architecture through to system bring-up and customer deployment. You will report to the Lead Firmware Engineer. Key Responsibilities: Architecture: Define FPGA requirements and architecture for SPAD sensor readout, in discussion with the hardware, ASIC and software teams. RTL Design: Implement, verify and debug Verilog modules for data acquisition, photon timing, histogramming and sensor control. Verification: Design and run simulations and testbenches, with coverage sufficient to trust the design before it reaches hardware. Synthesis & Timing: Own synthesis, constraints, clock domain crossing and timing closure on AMD-Xilinx FPGA family devices in Vivado. High-Speed Interfaces: Build and integrate the high-speed interfaces that move sensor data: PCIe, USB3, Ethernet, AXI interface, MIPI, LVDS, SLVS, Camera Link. jobs.title: Ingénieur PS Zero Trust / SASE (Cloudflare One)
jobs.description: À propos de Brixio Brixio est un partenaire spécialiste de Cloudflare : intégration, services professionnels et services managés sur l'ensemble de la plateforme, de la sécurité applicative au SASE. Brixio est partenaire Cloudflare certifié ASDP et fait partie depuis juillet 2026 du groupe Equans (groupe Bouygues), 18,7 Md€ de chiffre d'affaires et environ 85 000 personnes. L'équipe compte une trentaine d'ingénieurs répartis entre Paris, Dubaï et un centre de production à Casablanca. Les clients sont des grands comptes et des ETI en France, en Europe et au Moyen-Orient, ainsi que les entités du groupe Equans. La mission L'ingénieur PS Zero Trust / SASE déploie Cloudflare One chez les clients français de Brixio, du cadrage technique à la mise en production. Il devient la référence opérationnelle Zero Trust de l'équipe France et prend en charge les projets SASE dès son arrivée, notamment le déploiement interne de Cloudflare One chez Brixio et l'accès distant sécurisé aux sites industriels du groupe Equans. Il travaille avec le Delivery Manager France, qui pilote le planning, le budget et la relation projet, et avec l'architecte principal, référent technique de l'équipe. Responsabilités Cadrage : animer les ateliers techniques avec les équipes réseau, sécurité et poste de travail du client, puis rédiger le design détaillé (architecture d'accès, politiques, plan de migration). Déploiement Cloudflare One : Access (ZTNA), Gateway (SWG et filtrage DNS), client WARP, Tunnel, CASB, DLP, isolation de navigation (RBI), et selon les projets Magic WAN, Magic Firewall et Email Security. Migrations : remplacer les VPN par du ZTNA et les proxies existants par Gateway, sans rupture de service pour les utilisateurs. Intégrations : fournisseurs d'identité (Entra ID, Okta) en SAML, OIDC et SCIM, contrôles de posture (Intune, EDR), remontée des logs vers le SIEM du client. OT et industrie : sécuriser l'accès distant des prestataires et techniciens aux équipements industriels et technique

You'll join one of our Energy Solutions teams (spanning Building Automation, Horticulture, and Energy Flexibility Trading), landing wherever the need is greatest at the time, and you'll also carry some responsibility for the cloud infrastructure and scalability that benefits teams beyond your own. LogicSteel MRP ondersteunt hierbij operationele processen, zoals het plannen van productie, het beheren van projecten, inkooporders en het aansturen van medewerkers. Daarnaast zijn er systemen zoals Insights die machine- en prestatiegegevens inzichtelijk maken. Doordat informatie verdeeld is over meerdere applicaties, ontbreekt vaak één centraal overzicht voor resourceplanning en capaciteitsbeslissingen. Tijdens deze afstudeeropdracht onderzoek je hoe relevante gegevens uit deze systemen beter gecombineerd en gepresenteerd kunnen worden, zodat gebruikers sneller de juiste inzichten hebben voor het plannen van mensen, machines en productiecapaciteit. Je houdt je onder andere bezig met: Het analyseren van het huidige resourceallocatieproces en de rol van machine- en productiegegevens hierin; Het voeren van interviews met gebruikers om hun doelen, behoeften en knelpunten in kaart te brengen; Het onderzoeken welke data uit Insights en MRP relevant is voor besluitvorming; Het analyseren van gebruikersstromen, beschikbare data en bestaande schermen; Het ontwikkelen van wireframes, gebruikersflows en ontwerpconcepten; Het valideren en verbeteren van ontwerpen door middel van feedbacksessies met gebruikers en stakeholders; Het vertalen van gebruikersbehoeften naar functionele requirements; Het opstellen van een advies voor de integratie en presentatie van machinegegevens over verschillende platformen. Het eindresultaat is een onderbouwd ontwerp- en implementatievoorstel waarmee gebruikers sneller en beter onderbouwde beslissingen kunnen nemen op het gebied van resourceplanning en machinebezetting. WIJ VRAGEN HBO- of WO-opleiding in de richting van UI/UX Design, Human Computer Interaction, Interaction Technology of vergelijkbaar. In the Personalization team, you’ll build the experimentation platform that lets Picnic try new ideas safely and at scale: from which promotions to highlight to which emails to send. Your work lets business teams run experiments and control the customer experience themselves, without needing an engineer for every change. It’s a product that is foundational to our business, and it directly improves how customers shop every day. You don’t just implement requirements, you question them. Build bridges. You work with cross-functional teams across the whole business: the business teams who rely on the platform, fellow engineers, and the other consumer-facing teams whose features run through it. You make it easy for others to succeed. Drive things forward. You don’t wait for someone to hand you the next task. Als Lead Supply Chain Coördinator geef jij leiding aan het team dat iedere dag opnieuw zorgt dat de korte keten tussen leverancier en ons Warehouse zo goed mogelijk loopt. Zo kunnen we onze knetterverse producten altijd op tijd bij onze klanten bezorgen. Je staat zelf midden in de operatie, maar kijkt ook verder: je maakt de supply chain elke dag een stukje slimmer, bouwt aan de processen en manier van werken binnen je team, en zorgt voor een sterke samenwerking met ons warehouse. Zo bouw je mee aan een Supply Chain-afdeling waarmee we kunnen blijven groeien. Wat je gaat doen Als Lead Inbound Supply Chain Coördinator zorg jij er samen met je team voor dat onze leveranciers de juiste producten, op het goede moment, in de juiste hoeveelheid leveren. Hierdoor krijgen onze klanten hun producten vers bezorgd en kunnen we op ons Warehouse de voorraad zo laag mogelijk houden. Dat is een ingewikkelde puzzel die we elke dag een stukje slimmer willen oplossen. Jij geeft het team daarin richting, houdt de dagelijkse operatie scherp en verbetert tegelijk structureel. Je hebt veel contact met externe partijen zoals leveranciers, en met andere teams binnen Crisp zoals ons warehouse en het commerciële team. Een aantal van jouw verantwoordelijkheden zijn: Je bent leidinggevende van het Inbound Supply Chain-team. Je bewaakt samen met het team de dagelijkse supply chain performance en bent eindverantwoordelijk voor het oplossen van verstoringen. Waar nodig spring je zelf bij om bestellingen scherp te monitoren en snel te schakelen met leveranciers en interne teams. jobs.description: 01 · Why this role exists Invest in Values. Produce in Freedom. Boost Europe. Behind every megawatt hour our clients save, there are people who make it happen. RIZM helps Europe's largest industrial companies – together around 2% of Europe's total energy demand – make their energy decisions with AI. Our agent RIZMO works as a digital colleague. But the most important colleagues are the ones we haven't found yet. That's your job. We're about 15 people today and growing fast. There is no recruiting playbook yet, no big HR department and no "that's how we've always done it". You'll write the playbook. Not as application admin, but as the person who shapes who RIZM becomes. 02 · Hi, we're Diana and Josh – we'll be working together I'm Diana, 20, I study civil engineering in Münster and I currently run recruiting at RIZM on my own, 20 hours a week. Josh, our co-founder & CBO, comes from statistics and risk management and will be your sparring partner whenever you need one – for tricky candidates, for offers and for figuring out who we need next. 03 · What you'll do Build the team of tomorrow: Design our recruiting from scratch – roles, workflows, tools – and later bring more recruiters and sourcers on board yourself. jobs.title: Senior Robotics Engineer - State Estimation, VIO & Sensor Fusion
jobs.description: About Promethion Industries Promethion Industries is a European defence technology company building autonomous supremacy systems for aerial and multi-domain operations. Our mission is to enable decisive autonomy for NATO-aligned forces through tightly integrated autonomy stacks designed and built in Europe. Our focus is defensive and counter-system capabilities, including anti-UAS and resilient autonomy under contested conditions. We are looking for a Senior Robotics Engineer - State Estimation, VIO & Sensor Fusion to build the estimation backbone that allows our aircraft to understand their own motion without depending on GNSS. Your mission with us Build the state-estimation and sensor-fusion backbone of our autonomous aerial systems. Develop robust vehicle-state estimation for high-dynamic flight and GNSS-degraded or GNSS-denied environments. Fuse IMUs, cameras, optical flow, airspeed, GNSS, barometers and other sensors into reliable low-latency estimates. Develop, integrate and deploy VIO, visual odometry, ego-motion optical flow and inertial-estimation approaches. Own temporal calibration, sensor synchronisation, coordinate frames and estimator consistency. Diagnose drift, bias, observability and timing problems from first principles. Work directly with real flight logs and hardware to reproduce estimator failures and rapidly improve performance. Build graceful degradation when individual sensors become unreliable or unavailable. Quantify estimator uncertainty and expose meaningful confidence and health information to downstream autonomy and control systems. Evaluate alternative estimation architectures including direct velocity estimation and continuous-time approaches where they provide advantages at high dynamics. Your contribution to the team (required) Strong practical experience in robotics state estimation, localization or inertial estimation. Deep understanding of IMU-based estimation and multi-sensor fusion. Strong experience with EKF, error-state filte

jobs.title: Growth Manager (m/f/d)
jobs.description: Über Buena Buena (backed by GV) macht alles rund um Immobilien so einfach und transparent wie den Kauf eines ETFs. Ob Suchen, Kaufen oder Finanzieren einer Wohnung. Wir tun das, indem wir Hausverwaltungen in ganz Deutschland übernehmen und in Technologieunternehmen verwandeln. In den vergangenen drei Jahren sind wir mit weniger als 25 Vollzeitmitarbeitern im HQ zur drittgrößten Hausverwaltung Deutschlands geworden. Über die Rolle Wir verwalten über 70.000 Einheiten in ganz Deutschland. Das ist nicht das Geschäft, das ist die Plattform. Darauf bauen wir neue Verticals auf: Versicherung, Energie, Finanzierung und Brokerage. Für Brokerage suchen wir jetzt die Person, die daraus ein echtes Geschäft macht. Viele unserer Eigentümer wollen irgendwann verkaufen. Wir sitzen direkt an der Quelle und kennen Objekte, Eigentümer und Timing. Deine Aufgabe ist, daraus eine planbare Akquise-Maschine zu bauen: Du identifizierst die richtigen Eigentümer aus unserem Bestand, sprichst sie gezielt an und wandelst erstes Interesse in hochqualifizierte Leads für unsere Makler um. Das ist keine Strategie-Rolle mit Folien und Roadmaps. Du baust selbst: Kampagnen, Outbound-Workflows, Automatisierungen, Funnels. Du weißt jede Woche, welche Zahl du bewegt hast. Du arbeitest direkt mit dem Leadership-Team, ohne Hierarchie-Ebenen dazwischen. Deine Verantwortlichkeiten Akquise-Engine aufbauen: Du analysierst unseren Bestand, findest Eigentümer mit Verkaufsbedarf und baust Workflows für Datenanreicherung, Lead-Scoring und automatisierte Ansprache. Marketing selbst umsetzen: Du baust und optimierst die Kanäle, die Leads bringen, von Outbound über Performance-Kampagnen bis zu In-App-Triggern im richtigen Moment. Funnel und Zahlen verantworten: Du definierst KPIs vom Lead bis zum Mandat, trackst Kosten pro Lead und Conversion und optimierst so lange, bis die Unit Economics stimmen. Schnell testen: Daten-Trigger, Kanäle, Messaging und Lead-Magneten. Du hast eine klare Meinung, was du ausprobieren will

Over the past decade, we’ve grown from a meal-kit company into a global food solutions group, active across multiple brands including HelloFresh, Factor, Green Chef, EveryPlate, Chef’s Plate, and Youfoodz. As search behavior evolves across Google, AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Reddit, and other discovery surfaces, our SEO team is expanding its focus from traditional organic search to broader Organic Discovery: building the content, technical, authority, and measurement foundations that help customers find our brands wherever discovery and dinner decisions happen. We are looking for a Team Lead, SEO & GEO to lead our global Organic Discovery team and help shape the next phase of how HelloFresh Group approaches organic growth. This role will lead a team of SEO/GEO specialists and work across international markets to translate global strategy into scalable programs that grow non-brand organic demand, strengthen our visibility across traditional and AI-driven search, and improve the quality and discoverability of our content. This is a highly cross-functional leadership role. You will partner closely with Product, Engineering, Analytics, Content, Brand, and local Marketing teams to identify opportunities, prioritize the highest-impact work, and build scalable solutions across brands and markets. You’ll need to be equally comfortable setting strategy, coaching a team, digging into performance data, and influencing senior stakeholders to move complex initiatives forward.   What you’ll do Lead, coach, and develop a team of SEO/GEO specialists, setting clear priorities and creating an environment of strong ownership, collaboration, and continuous development. jobs.title: Senior UX Strategist & Researcher (f/m/x)
jobs.description: The role HelloFresh is going AI-first. Join us in leading the shift and shaping the global customer experience. As a Senior UX Strategist & Researcher on our UX team, you ll own work from ambiguous brief to strategic outcome and implementation — defining project needs, using innovative research approaches, prototyping direction instead of presenting findings, and walking into executive meetings with a decision artifact, not a summary. The most valued teammates today aren t the ones who run the most studies. They shape which questions get asked, challenge business assumptions before money is spent, and stay in the room to drive the decision.  You ll use AI fluently as a genuine creative and strategic partner throughout the product design lifecycle. Strategy and research are your deepest strengths, but you’ll also work across the wider UX practice. We’re looking for people who go deep in one area and can take interface design, service design, and content to a solid minimum quality standard on their own, using AI to move fast, and who know when a problem needs a specialist’s depth. Above all, we are looking for people who will  make HelloFresh   better.  We believe there are many different ways of developing skills and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don’t “tick all the boxes” but think you’d thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you. What you’ll do Lead strategic research for insights to action: Own the end-to-end research and strategy work streams, from scoping through execution to insight delivery and application, balancing primary, secondary, qualitative and quantitative methods. Shape experiences across the ecosystem: Partner with product, design, marketing, operations, and business teams to understand and shape experiences across the full customer and service ecosystem. By combining technology, media and deep automotive expertise, we've turned how people buy, sell, advertise and lease cars on its head. Right now it's the opposite: a dealer buys through us, then has to manage collection, payment and resale largely on their own, stitching together workflows across multiple platforms and channels, much of it manual. For a dealer, speed is money. Every extra day a car sits before it's collected, priced, and paid for is a day of depreciation, tied-up capital, and a missed chance to buy the next one.If we can get a dealer from 'I've bought this car' to 'it's ready and paid for' faster through transport and collections, quicker final pricing, and Wallet, we make them more profitable. A dealer who's more profitable because of Carwow has little reason to go elsewhere: they'll lean on us more, and churn less. This role owns that last-mile agenda: getting cars collected quickly, resolving final price without friction, and making Wallet work the way dealers expect it to. jobs.description: This is your opportunity to join a small group of obsessed game makers, building an ambitious mobile game focused on collection and social. As our founding UI & UX Artist you will be the owner of the entire UX structure at a high level, down to the UI art pixels in detail. You will work intimately with engineers, artists, designers from the vision level, down to the hands on implementation. jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description: At Brevo, we’re not just building a CRM. With our technology, we’re helping millions of organizations build lasting relationships with their customers. From emails and SMS to WhatsApp, Chat, and Marketing Automation, our tools are intuitive, powerful, and built to scale with every ambition. We give businesses a clear view of the customer journey, so they can focus on what matters: connection. As a certified B Corp , we’re proud to grow with purpose, committed to high standards of social and environmental impact, not just performance. Today, more than 500,000 businesses across 180 countries —from NGOs like Amnesty International to global brands like Carrefour, eBay, Louis Vuitton, and Michelin—trust Brevo to engage their audiences, cut through complexity, and deliver results. Our reliable technology and 75+ integrations help them create unparalleled customer experiences, without the usual tech headaches. We recently exceeded 200m ARR and reached a major milestone by becoming a Unicorn , backed by strong growth and global expansion - and we’re just getting started! As Senior Product Manager in our Pro Business Unit, you'll own the mid-market product line end to end. You'll lead a "pod" - a small, cross-functional team of a PM or designer, and 2-3 full-stack engineers - through the whole cycle: identifying the problem, shaping the solution, building it, shipping it, and measuring the result. You're the single point of accountability for that team. The role blends product management, product design, and engineering judgment, all supported by AI tools. So we welcome candidates from a PM, design, or engineering background, as long as you're comfortable working across all three. You'll report into the Product Engineering director within the BU, alongside other pods led by senior PMs, designers, or engineering managers. jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description: Wanna join the adventure? At Loft, we are convinced that space programs should not have to be rebuilt from scratch every time. Our philosophy has been to productize them: we develop our own proprietary technology blocks, hardware and software, so that a customer payload can be integrated faster and more reliably than any bespoke program allows. That approach has delivered — it is why our customers reach orbit in months rather than years, and it is what makes working here different from working in the rest of the industry. We are now taking the next step: launching and operating our own constellations, and building a new set of services on top of them. That includes a full product suite enabling third-party AI applications to run directly onboard our satellites, and a growing ecosystem of partners whose needs we have to understand and design for. Loft is expanding at a very high pace, and the range of what we build is expanding just as fast. This is why Product Management matters so much here. Someone has to hold the whole picture — what is technically possible, what customers actually need, what we should build first — and turn it into something engineering and leadership can act on. As a Product Manager, you will own a significant perimeter and the autonomy that goes with it. We are growing the team precisely so that each of us can go deeper on our topics, anticipate rather than react, and have more impact across the company. You will need to be comfortable talking to anyone here. In the same week you might sit with a system engineer to understand a design constraint, join a BD call with an institutional customer, and present a recommendation to the executive team. Ideas at Loft get discussed openly and on their merits, wherever they come from, so being able to ask a naive question without ego — and to disagree with someone senior without making it personal — matters more than seniority. jobs.description: About Pelico Traditional industrial manufacturing systems were built for predictability. Supply chains no longer are. Today, real-time data is buried in legacy tools that weren't designed for constant disruption. By the time an issue surfaces, it has already snowballed, sending everyone into firefighting mode. Pelico exists to close the gap between production plans and the daily reality on the factory floor. We've built the manufacturing orchestration platform trusted by the world's most complex industrial operations : companies like Airbus, Boeing, Safran, Eaton, and Cartier. Our AI connects fragmented supply chain, production, and quality data into a single live operational picture — then puts AI agents to work anticipating disruptions, simulating recovery options, and keeping every team aligned before small problems become expensive ones. Founded in 2019 and backed by General Catalyst, 83North, and Serena, we've raised $72M and are growing fast — 300% year-over-year revenue growth, deployed in 15+ countries, and supporting factories worldwide. We're headquartered in Paris, with offices in Miami, London and Amsterdam, and we're just getting started. This is a rare chance to join a company that's redefining an industry that hasn't been disrupted in decades — from the inside. We work hand-in-hand with Sales and BDRs to create qualified pipeline with the largest industrial companies in the world.
